svg.title: gpushare: Suspend for a Checkpoint, Resume After a Restore
svg.desc: Capture: nvsnap-gpu-suspend quiesces every process that loads the gpushare library, releases the GPU memory they share and saves their cuMem allocations to the chunk store, then locks and checkpoints them through the CUDA checkpoint API and holds them frozen; on stop, the agent dumps them with CRIU. A failed step is rolled back and the workload runs on. Restore: after CRIU restores the processes, resume restores and unlocks them in the driver, loads the saved allocations at the same addresses, re-imports shared memory and multicast objects, and reopens kernel launches.
svg.text: gpushare: Suspend for a Checkpoint, Resume After a Restore
Each step is a command to every process's gpushare control thread, or a CUDA checkpoint API call. Solid paths are the normal run; the dashed path is the rollback.
run by the agent inside the pod's pid and network namespaces
64 MiB content-addressed chunks; a chunk already stored
is not written again; all-zero chunks are not stored
Restore: CRIU restore, then nvsnap-gpu-suspend resume
--gpu-map onto the placeholder's GPUs; --fabric-map across nodes
Quiesce holds every process's kernel and graph launches, copies and memsets in a gate and drains the GPU. Across nodes, each node votes and none releases until every node is quiesced
Release unmaps memory imported from other processes (NCCL P2P, CUDA IPC, fabric handles), drops multicast objects, unregisters host memory, and saves then frees the cuMem allocations;
Load re-creates the saved allocations; 9 remap re-imports from each exporter, with new fabric handles exchanged between nodes; 10 resume rejoins multicast and reopens launches. Pointers and
